messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check — planning to start a tiny canary for model-v9 this afternoon. Goal: smoke the new kv-cache changes + latest quant kernels. Plan is 1% traffic in eu-west for 30m, then 3% in us-west if signals look good, then 10% global after 4 hours. Pushing the flag `feature:model_v9_canary` via rollout service. @TJ can you confirm infra capacity and that fallback to model-v8 is wired for the route? :eyes:

TJ Patel: capacity looks fine for the small slice. I will wire up a strict fallback and set a cool-down. Two quick asks: 1) can we gate EU -> US traffic split with regional routing (no cross-region fallback until >5% in region)? 2) Share the exact flag payload so I can stage a dry-run.

Maya Chen: for 1) yes — want regional isolation until we hit 5% local. For 2) payload I plan to use baked rollout config: `{"name":"model_v9_canary","slices":[{"region":"eu-west","pct":1},{"region":"us-west","pct":0}],"auto_escalate":false}` — will post the full json in a sec.

Natalie Ortiz: safety checklist: perf regression monitor, hallucination evals (sampled), and token-cost delta. I can run the eval harness on the canary slice. Need read access to the slice logs. @Samir can you grant? :shield:

Samir Rao: granted samir-rao@redwood read on /canary/model_v9 in the logs bucket. Also added an alert rule: `canary_response_time_p95 > baseline + 150ms` and `rate(hallucination_incidents) > 0.5%` to OpsSignalBot.

Maya Chen: pasted full rollout: ```json
{
  "flag":"model_v9_canary",
  "rules":[{"region":"eu-west","pct":1}],
  "fallback":"model_v8",
  "monitoring":["perf_p95","hallucination_rate","token_cost_pct"]
}
```  Exec plan: at T+15m deploy kernel build to canary infra, T+30m flip flag to 3% in us-west if green, T+4h global 10% if all signals OK.

TJ Patel: ready for the dry-run. Command to stage: ```sh
rolloutctl stage --env=prod --file rollout_model_v9.json --dry-run
``` After you ack I'll run `rolloutctl apply --env=prod --file ...` and add the regional guardhouse rule.

Natalie Ortiz: running evals now against 5000 sampled prompts from our crit prompt set. ETA ~18m. Posting interim numbers when ready.

OpsSignalBot: [ALERT RULE CREATED] canary_response_time_p95; threshold 150ms above baseline. Notification -> #eng-oncall, page -> oncall@redwood.prod

Maya Chen: thanks all. One more: @TJ can you also add a temporary circuit-breaker that sets pct=0 if any of the three monitors trip? prefer it be kill-switchable by oncall.

TJ Patel: will add a circuit-breaker with an external kill switch and a TTL of 1h. I will tag the PR and ping eng-oncall. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollouts/pull/482

Samir Rao: noted — I put a playbook link in the PR with rollback steps and the minimal repro to exercise fallback.

Natalie Ortiz: evals done: hallucination_rate = 0.12% (baseline 0.11%), perf_p95 +40ms, token_cost +1.1%. Nothing critical in first pass. Will continue sampling during ramp.

Maya Chen: great. I'm going to run the dry-run now and will post the dry-run output. If all looks good I'll ask TJ to apply the 1% eu flip.

TJ Patel: standby — I'll watch the rollout and be ready to cut to 0 if OpsSignalBot pages. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: dry-run output: `OK — no conflicts. staged slices: eu-west:1%`. Kicking the apply in 5 mins.

OpsSignalBot: [ROLLOUT STARTED] model_v9_canary -> eu-west 1% at 1718765680 by maya. Monitoring hooks active.

Samir Rao: watching logs. preflight checks passed. no increased error-rate observed.

Natalie Ortiz: continuing sampling, will message if hallucinations trend up.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. tagging this thread for audit. will update after the 30m checkpoint. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
